private_lines.Leah: You work as a retail manager at a clothing store in Stratford, running the shop floor and the rota. You share a flat in Walthamstow with Rosie, and your days are split between shifts, the gym and catching up with friends.
private_lines.Samir: You work as a sales analyst for a software firm in the City, spending most weekdays at a desk. You live alone in Camden, and evenings are usually spent cooking, gaming or watching football at home.
private_lines.Rosie: You work as a physiotherapist at an NHS clinic in Walthamstow, with full days of appointments and sessions. You live with Leah in the flat, and your evenings go to the gym, running or the occasional class.
private_lines.Robbie: You run your own plumbing business, taking call-outs across north London from an early start. You live alone in Hackney, and your days go to jobs in the van, with quiet evenings over a pint or the telly.

situation: Friends going to a football match.
topic: What is the bag size limit at the Emirates Stadium?

text: Anyone know the bag size limit at emirates? Thinking whether my rucksack will get in 👀
No idea sorry. I'd just bring a small bag if it's a home game lol
Lol ok. I'll check the club site later
Think they've got a clear bag policy for most of the stadium? Not 100% though
Ah ok. Might just leave it at home then
Did you sort the train or are we going from walthamstow
Not sorted yet sorry. Was going to do victoria line to highbury and walk. Might be quicker the overground? 🤔
Morning! Victoria is fine. I'll check times when I'm out. Are you taking the rucksack?
Not sure. Haven't checked the club site yet
Might just take my purse and phone
Piccadilly from camden is direct to arsenal station. I'm sorted for that. Meet at the station?
Got a boiler call out in stoke newington first. Might be late, will get there when I can
Ok Robbie. Just let us know
Good luck. Ill save you a seat
Leaving in 20 if anyone's going from walthamstow
Still getting ready 😅 go without me, ill be 10 mins behind
Ok
Just got to the station. Where are you lot
Holloway rd end of the chippy. Come round 🍟
In. Got to the ground. Dont know where you are
Ill come find you
That was tense
Lol yes
Robbie you still in one piece
Yeah, all fine. Pint now
Home. Feet dead
Same. Going to bed early tonight, Monday's a full day
Home. Long one
Anyone up for five a side thurs? Same place as usual
Cant, on call thurs. Maybe the week after
Morning. Thurs is fine for me if it's 7 or later. Who else is in?
Morning. Will check the pitch, usually the 8pm one is free. Might be just us 4 if Robbie's out
I'm in for thurs after work. Done at 5 so 7 or later is fine
Morning all 😅 full day ahead
[photo: bathroom sink with a burst pipe, water across the lino]
Customer panicking, got it stopped tho
Home. Knackered. Prob no gym tmrw 😴
Thai on the way home or are you too tired
Thai yes please 🙏
Will book the 8pm Thurs in the morning if no one's said otherwise. Going to bed
